checkerNotes: RESTRICTED-NETWORK MODE: a test WebFetch of the first listing URL returned EGRESS_BLOCKED (proxy blocks all direct page fetches, matching the finder's own report), so this entire review is search-corroboration only — no listing page was read. All 9 listings pass on that standard: each is either currently indexed on the company's own ATS domain (job-boards.greenhouse.io/opentable for the iOS, Data, PM and AI reqs; jobs.ashbyhq.com/kayak for all three KAYAK roles) or corroborated by multiple independent mirrors (Priceline R5644; OpenTable general SWE internship), and no closure signal (no longer accepting, position filled) appeared in any snippet. Accordingly every pass carries unverified-liveness (network-restricted) and description-unread — liveness, deadlines, exact eligibility and visa language must all be re-verified from an unrestricted network before publishing. Repairs: the AI Automation Intern was upgraded from its LinkedIn fallback to its now-indexed Greenhouse page (8348802002). Remaining weak spot: the general Software Engineer Internship still has no indexed Greenhouse URL and its exact LinkedIn job ID no longer appears in the index (the listing itself is corroborated by Glassdoor, Jobs.ca, Built In and Welcome to the Jungle) — re-locate its canonical URL first. Freshness: the four OpenTable 8216xxx002 reqs predate the AI req (8348802002, ~Jan 2026 per Built In), placing their original postings around Oct-Nov 2025, hence stale-posting on all five OpenTable listings; countervailing evidence says they remain open (Built In actively-hiring flags with 5-14-day repost bumps, ZipRecruiter OpenTable Toronto page headed Aug 2026). One search summary mentioned an OpenTable Toronto internship term of May 4 - Aug 28, 2026 (which, if it applied to these reqs, would mean the cohort already started), but a targeted follow-up search could not attribute those dates to any of these listings via an actual source page, so it was not treated as a closure signal — check program term dates explicitly on direct fetch. Visa audit: all nine arrived as Not Mentioned with null evidence, no snippet showed sponsorship or right-to-work language for any listing, so nothing needed downgrading and nothing was upgraded. Duplicate check: first run, seenListings empty — no duplicates possible; the two OpenTable SWE internships (iOS vs general) are distinct reqs mirrored separately on Built In. Search budget used: 1 test fetch + 12 searches for 9 listings, within the ~2-per-listing-plus-repairs allowance.
